_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Vantu yomboli Snake kwa {width}×{height} ndaka.
Ovu kontrolla yomboli {player_id}. Vipindi vyovya: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kana w/s/a/d).
Kulunga: kulikala kwavulu kwa mpindi mukwawo, kana uwe yomboli mukwawo uye we mukwawo matala (kikomo kyovya {max_turns} vipindi).

game_action.invalid_death: Onyoha {player_id} ya fa omo okuti ka yi kuete omoko yoku linga cimue.

outcome.all_dead_simul: Eci olonyõha via fetika oku iñila vocimbaluku, ovio via fa.
outcome.outlived: Omunu ohwa mu kala kwawo aze.
outcome.turn_limit: Kuenje, o linga ohundo ya velapo vokuenda kueteke.
